title: model-routes
requirement: The current model ids and routes for three route families: (a) the Anthropic API (vendor model pages and release notes, read and dated; the claude-api skill's model and pricing references); (b) OpenAI through OmniRoute (the Codex models page; OmniRoute's own model listing and release notes at its running pin); (c) Meta's Muse through the muse-code provider (Wonder Full; dev.meta.ai docs; the Muse fence decisions). For each route: model id; route (client + provider + endpoint class); the pin it was read at; effort and tier controls; limits; pricing or plan class; adoption status today (CURRENT, TRIAL, NOT_ADOPTED); each verified with a dated primary source or marked UNVERIFIED with the cheapest check. Selection serves the NativeHorizonNY harness (TRIAL labels only from this sweep).
next_action: Initial sweep scoped to the gap (layer-resolution protocol step 3): adjudicate the 14 carried angle candidates and propose new routes only with primary sources.

layer_instructions: CANDIDATE IDENTITY FOR THIS LAYER: a candidate is a model ROUTE (client + provider + endpoint class + model id). Use repository = '<primary vendor doc URL>#<route-id>' with a lowercase kebab route-id (the carried set's route_identity values follow this form). A tool repository (client, gateway, SDK) keeps its canonical GitHub URL as the selection principles say. The 90-day default-branch maintenance rule applies to repositories; for a vendor-hosted model route, judge currency from the vendor's dated model page, release notes or changelog and record it in upstream_now (latest_release = model id or version, released_at = the vendor's date; null where unknowable).

CARRIED SET: each of the 14 carried_candidates must be adjudicated. List every one in proposed[] under its route_identity with your label, demonstrated_gap, comparison_that_would_overturn, evidence and upstream_now. They do not count toward the cap of 6 proposals, which applies to NEW candidates only. The refuters vote on every carried candidate.

REQUIREMENT FIELDS: state each route's adoption status today (CURRENT, TRIAL, NOT_ADOPTED), effort and tier controls, limits and pricing or plan class inside demonstrated_gap or evidence text, each with its dated source URL.

FENCES: read-only research only. No keyed API call and no invocation of any Anthropic, OpenAI or Meta model. The Muse fence decisions hold: docs/decisions/2026-10-14-muse-file-fence.md and docs/decisions/2026-10-15-muse-toolchain-directory-grants.md in the repository worktree named in input_provenance.

INDEPENDENCE: a GPT-family half of this sweep runs separately and stays sealed until both halves finish. Do not read pull requests of seathatflowsinourveins/native-agent-stack (also served as native-agent-stack/native-agent-stack) about model routes, nor any evidence/artifacts/model-routes-sweep-* directory. Your returns must be independent.
